description: This source file defines the TvIndexActivity class, which is an Android activity responsible for displaying a TV-oriented landing screen. It loads a specific HTML page into a WebView, manages focus and key events for TV navigation, and includes buttons to navigate to instructions or about screens.

classes.name: TvIndexActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity designed as a TV-first landing page that loads an HTML index into a WebView and handles focus/navigation for TV remote controls.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that sets up the activity layout, initializes buttons, WebView, and focus behavior.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Overrides key events to handle BACK button presses for activity termination.

methods.name: prepareTvWebView
methods.description: Configures WebView settings to optimize for TV display and interaction, enabling JavaScript, setting zoom controls, and handling key events.
